title: Kostant integral form and ordered triangular monomials
statement: Let $L$ be a rational Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra] and let $U_{\mathbf Q}=U(L)$ be its universal enveloping algebra, namely the unital tensor-algebra quotient with relations $xy-yx=[x,y]$, with canonical map $\iota:L\to U_{\mathbf Q}$. For any unital associative rational algebra $A$, $x\in A$ and $n\in\mathbf N$, define $x^{(n)}=(n!)^{-1}x^n$ and $\binom{x}{n}=(n!)^{-1}\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(x-k)$, with products in increasing order and empty product $1$. For a family $e:I\to L$, define $U_{\mathbf Z}(e)$ to be the unital $\mathbf Z$-subalgebra of $U_{\mathbf Q}$ generated by all $\iota(e_i)^{(n)}$, $i\in I$, $n\ge0$. For ordered families $h_1,\ldots,h_r$, $f_1,\ldots,f_N$, $g_1,\ldots,g_N$ in $L$, and $a,c\in\mathbf N^N$, $b\in\mathbf N^r$, define the triangular monomial to be $(\prod_j\iota(f_j)^{(a_j)})(\prod_i\binom{\iota(h_i)}{b_i})(\prod_j\iota(g_j)^{(c_j)})$, preserving each indicated order. Empty families and the zero Lie algebra are allowed.
